meta.title: Sprout
meta.description: Credits, debts, investments and goals in one calm place, for you, your household or your company.

overview.title: Overview
overview.emptyBody: Start with what you already have. Sprout builds your picture as you add to it.

steps.title: Add an account
steps.body: A checking account, a card or cash. This anchors your balance.

steps.title: Record what you owe or are owed
steps.body: Loans, installments and money lent, with the dates they matter.

steps.title: Set a goal
steps.body: A reserve, a trip or a purchase. Sprout tracks the distance, not the pressure.
